Cellular overview of DEPs and their potential roles in altering the metabolic pathways of S

Cellular overview of DEPs and their potential roles in altering the metabolic pathways of S. acuminata under PA repression. The red text indicates upregulated proteins, while blue text indicates downregulated ones. The bold text indicates the proteins whose expression patterns are consistent with their corresponding genes in transcriptomic level, while the underlined text indicates the proteins whose expression patterns are opposite to their corresponding genes in transcriptomic level. For a detailed list of abbreviations, refer to Table S7
